findings.finding: The candidate production method and worker production branch can be reached by caller-supplied, internally consistent receipt files; those files are not an external trust root and production must remain unconditionally closed before pipe creation, Popen, or scientific imports.

A future executable route must be a new versioned controller/worker successor bound to the reviewed v4 outer, v4 PASS receipt, wrapper review and dispatch receipts, and exact code/module/argv/cwd/environment/host authority; the current candidate cannot be opened in place.
The controller does not yet provide independently reviewable host-commit preflight, child-private-commit monitoring, exact owned-child stop semantics, or fail-closed sampling behavior.
The single-active and attempt-consumption transition is not protected by a lock, so concurrent callers can race before spawn.

The scientific bridge does not freeze and live-verify the complete recovery and staging dependency closure or exercise resolved, certificate and exception semantics through a registered zero-solver seam.
